text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Tokyo Daishoten draws near…

text_block_list.name: TV Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: I think it's safe to say that Oguri Cap made quite the impact this year! What does she have in store for us at the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: TV Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: Considering that Tamamo Cross has announced she'll be taking some time off after this race…

text_block_list.name: TV Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: The clash is slated to be a highlight of their generation. It'll be the third time Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap face off.

text_block_list.name: TV Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: With Super Creek now in the running too, how will the top junior-year runner fare?

text_block_list.name: TV Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Things will get even more interesting if Inari One decides to compete. My expectations for next year are high…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The talk about the Arima Kinen mounts with every passing day. Excitement surrounding the race greatly exceeds past years.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wow, Oguri and Creek are in the spotlight now! Those two really are a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I might not be running with 'em, but seein' them kickin' up such a ruckus makes me wanna get out there 'n' win even more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By sheer coincidence, Inari One is close with many of the projected favorites for this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross—famed for her lightning-quick speed and impressive track record—has many hailing her as the peak of Japan's racing scene as of late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek—a runner with a keen sense and plenty of endurance— has climbed up the ranks in record time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the Beast who's plowed her way to the center of everyone's attention… Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is particularly close with Oguri Cap and Super Creek. The three consider each other good friends and rivals.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ya know, I wonder if it's fate sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nah, maybe… inevitability is the better word more like.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Remember the day ya first showed me around Tracen? We saw Oguri and Creek in the middle of a partner run.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Remember the day ya first showed me around Tracen? We saw Oguri and Creek in the middle of a partner run.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I kinda… felt somethin' strange watching 'em.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I couldn't put my finger on it back then… But now I feel like I'm startin' to understand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Back then, I had this sudden idea like we're all "fated" to compete one day.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But now I feel like it's "inevitable" that future race is gonna become this humongous festival.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Haha! Listen to me, jabberin' on with this nonsense! You can forget about all that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Inari One continues to compete in the centrals through her senior year, she'll be up against some of the best runners, including Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The same people who gave her the push to enroll in Tracen will reappear as formidable foes. It's almost as though…
choice_data_list: I think it's both fate and inevitability.
I think it's both fate and inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait to face off with them in my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But before that, we got a goal to achieve this year!
choice_data_list: Right. Let's win the Tokyo Daishoten.
Right. Let's win the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I wanna enter my senior year standin' on top of the regionals! Let's finish off with a bang!
